task.title: Recording your first track
task.shortdesc: Make your first recording in : pick a microphone, record, stop and play it back.

context.p: This task walks you through making your first audio recording. You need a microphone connected to your computer. If you are new to audio terms such as sample rate and clipping, read first.

info.p: On first launch opens an empty project window with a gray waveform area.

step.cmd: Select your microphone from the recording device list in the Device Toolbar.

info.p: The Device Toolbar is near the top of the window. The recording device list has a microphone icon next to it. Click a control in the picture to read about it.

image.alt: The Device Toolbar: audio host, recording device, channels and playback device

step.cmd: Click Record, or press R, to start recording.

info.p: A blue waveform appears as captures audio from your microphone, like .
info.note: A flat line instead of a waveform means the microphone is not selected correctly. Click Stop and check the recording device.

step.cmd: Speak into your microphone, or play the audio you want to capture.
Click Stop when you are finished.
Click Play to listen to your recording.

result.p: You now have a recorded audio track in your project. The waveform shows the shape of the recorded audio: louder sounds appear as taller waves.

postreq.p: Trim the false starts (), then export the result ().
